title: Drafting channel registry (src/config/drafting-channels.yml)
$comment: road-to-channel-contract-and-profile-drift Phase 1.2. Validated by tests/scripts/drafting_channels_schema.test.ts against the Draft-07 SUBSET exported by src/scripts/validate_frontmatter.ts (type, required, properties, additionalProperties:false, items, minItems, pattern, minLength, enum) — no $ref, no patternProperties, no if-then, because that validator supports none of them and a schema using them would silently not be checked. SCOPE: an output shape for prose this package writes. Deliberately NOT merged into reach-channels.schema.json: a reach channel is an external retrieval backend with an install string, a health probe and a lifecycle, and a drafting channel has none of those and carries a length and a cadence instead; a merged schema would make every field optional for half its rows. The `id` values are FLAG VALUES — what a user types after `--channel=` — which is why the enum is closed: the short form `linkedin` is the plausible typo, and an open enum would accept it silently.

schema_version.description: Registry format version. Bumped only on a breaking shape change.

channels.description: The `--channel` enum, one entry per accepted flag value. Order carries no meaning.

id.description: The literal `--channel=` value. Closed enum: adding a drafting channel is a contract change to docs/contracts/write-engine.md and to the three command surfaces, so it may not be done by adding a row here alone.

length_default.description: Default word count when `--length` is omitted. Mirrors the Length-default column of write-engine.md § Per-channel defaults.

cadence.description: Paragraph/structure guidance for this channel. Mirrors the Cadence-guidance column of write-engine.md § Per-channel defaults.
